verdict.rationale: Notte publishes its own per-framework integration guides. The CrewAI guide has crews point at the Notte MCP server, and the Vercel AI SDK guide wires a TypeScript agent's MCP client to the same server. Claude Managed Agents and Claude Code guides drive browsers through the Notte CLI, and there is also an OpenAI CUA integration. These are documented first-party integrations, but they run through MCP or CLI rather than native framework adapters. Missing for 10: LangChain integration, explicit Claude Agent SDK adapter docs, native (non-MCP) tool adapters, independent hands-on corroboration.
